owner_behavior: Read the index and admitted both correctly named children with the exact assigned prompts. Executed two follow-up cells sending numeric lines 100-104 to each child (four delivered messages total), then failed on nonexistent observation helpers. Never stored incoming receipts in an explicit receipt map or assembled a file. Repeated list-versus-dict indexing and malformed assembly code. Later code contained further sends, but preceding exceptions prevented those sends from executing.
alice_behavior: Loaded the source into a string but displayed only line/nonempty-line counts, then issued two empty IPython calls while interpreting numeric parent messages as progress. Actual model-visible empty-call recovery instructed writing the summary before sending, with a conditional stop if a send had already succeeded. The model incorrectly reasoned that the parent had said the send succeeded, then sent the assigned absolute-path receipt without any summary write and stopped. No summary file exists.
bennett_behavior: Loaded source text but initially displayed line count and sorted characters. Called read_text on that string, then recovered only by showing the first paragraph. Sent a relative chapter-002/summary.md receipt without any write and stopped. No summary file exists.
interpretation: No useful completion or semantic improvement established. Unlike R4/R10, neither chapter file was written in this run. R10 weights were unchanged, but owner-generated traffic and resulting child contexts differed; this is not an isolated worker regression measurement. One small development trial does not establish a stable causal effect of R5 training.
